import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea"""
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8))

plt.subplot(2, 2, 1)
sns.barplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df)
plt.title('Average Sleep Duration by BMI Category')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 2)
sns.barplot(x='Occupation', y='Daily Steps', data=df)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.title('Daily Steps by Occupation')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 3)
sns.scatterplot(x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', hue='Sleep Disorder', data=df)
plt.title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps')

plt.subplot(2, 2, 4)
sns.barplot(x='Stress Level', y='Sleep Duration', data=df)
plt.title('Sleep Duration by Stress Level')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png')
